title: Safety Shutdown / Heat Exchanger Overheat
shortDescription: Vitodens supply temperature exceeded the safety limit.
fullDescription:
F.02 on Vitodens 100/200 means the supply STB or temperature limiter has tripped. Causes are loss of flow (failed circulator, air lock, closed isolation valve), excessive scale on the heat exchanger, or a failed temperature sensor reading high.

The boiler stays in lockout until the technician resets the panel.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass the STB; over-temp protects against catastrophic HX failure.

fixSteps.title: Bleed
fixSteps.instruction: Vent the boiler and high points; verify pressure 1-1.5 bar.

fixSteps.title: Check pump
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm pump runs and supply piping warms during a heat call.

whenToCallPro: Heat exchanger descale and pump replacement.

faq.a: Yes — scale buildup is the leading cause on aged Vitodens 100s.

title: No Flame Signal
shortDescription: Burner did not establish flame after ignition retries.
fullDescription:
F.04 is the Vitodens ignition lockout. After failed retries the unit holds in fault until reset. Typical causes: closed gas valve, contaminated electrode, low gas pressure, or LP outage.

Reset by holding the reset button for ~3 seconds and watching one ignition cycle.
safetyWarning: If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas emergency line.

fixSteps.title: Confirm gas
fixSteps.instruction: Verify shutoff valve at the boiler is open.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the reset button until the display clears.

fixSteps.title: Clean ionization probe
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, remove the probe, lightly polish, gap to spec.

whenToCallPro: Gas pressure or valve work needs a Vitodens-trained tech.

faq.q: Does Vitodens have a flame-rod separate from spark?
faq.a: Yes — the ionization probe is separate from the spark electrode.

title: Exhaust Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Flue gas thermistor open or shorted.
fullDescription:
F.05 indicates the flue temperature sensor is out of range. The Vitodens uses this sensor to limit firing rate when stack temperature climbs above safe limits for the polypropylene vent.

Common failures are connector corrosion or sensor probe failure after years in condensate.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass — flue over-temperature can damage plastic vent.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connector
fixSteps.instruction: Pull and reseat the flue sensor harness.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Swap with the OEM Viessmann sensor.

whenToCallPro: If the sensor seal must be reset on the flue collector.

faq.a: No — the flue sensor is required for safe operation.

title: Ionization / Flame Loss During Run
shortDescription: Flame went out unexpectedly during a heating cycle.
fullDescription: F.07 occurs when an established flame is lost during a burn. Look for an oxidized ionization probe, condensate ingress on the burner, or low gas supply pressure under load.
safetyWarning: Investigate before pushing reset multiple times.
symptoms: Heat for short period then off

fixSteps.title: Polish probe
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, lightly polish ionization probe with emery cloth.

whenToCallPro: Combustion analyzer check is recommended after F.07 events.

faq.a: High humidity and minerals build up on the ionization rod over time.

title: Outdoor Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Outdoor reset sensor open or short.
fullDescription:
F.09 is informational; the Vitodens cannot read the outdoor sensor and reverts to the highest defined setpoint.

Check the wiring run and the sensor itself (typical 10K NTC).
safetyWarning: No safety issue — comfort/efficiency only.

fixSteps.title: Inspect run
fixSteps.instruction: Walk the cable and look for chew marks or breaks.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap with the OEM Viessmann outdoor sensor.

whenToCallPro: Only if access requires a ladder you are not comfortable with.

faq.a: Yes, but at fixed setpoint.

title: Outdoor Sensor Short Circuit
fullDescription: F.10 differs from F.09 in that the sensor circuit is shorted (resistance near zero). Diagnosis is the same — check wiring, replace sensor.
safetyWarning: No safety issue.
whenToCallPro: If wire path is inaccessible.

faq.a: Operates at fixed setpoint until repaired.

title: Boiler Sensor Open Circuit
fullDescription: F.11 indicates the main supply NTC has failed open. The boiler will not fire.
safetyWarning: Power off before disconnecting any sensor.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the OEM NTC if open.

whenToCallPro: If the well is part of the heat exchanger and requires draining.

faq.a: Yes — Viessmann uses a specific NTC curve; do not substitute.

title: Boiler Sensor Short Circuit
fullDescription: F.12 mirrors F.11 but for a shorted sensor (resistance ≈ 0). Same diagnostic flow.
safetyWarning: Power off before disconnecting the sensor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Look for pinch or burn marks.

whenToCallPro: If draining is required.

faq.a: Yes — different failure mode, same part.

title: Safety Shutdown / Internal Communication
shortDescription: Communication loss between boiler control and safety chip.
fullDescription: F.20 is reported when the supervisory safety microcontroller stops responding to the main control. This is rarely a field-fixable issue; the control PCB usually requires replacement.
safetyWarning: Disconnect power before opening the cabinet.

fixSteps.title: Schedule service
fixSteps.instruction: Have a Viessmann tech replace the control board.

whenToCallPro: Always for control board work.

faq.q: Can I source the board myself?
faq.a: Boards may be brand-locked; let the tech procure.

title: Dry Fire / Low Water
shortDescription: Boiler ran without water flow or below minimum pressure.
fullDescription: F.22 is reported when the supply temperature rises faster than possible with adequate flow, indicating dry-fire conditions. The Vitodens locks out and requires verification of system fill and pump function.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass; dry firing destroys the heat exchanger.
whenToCallPro: If pump replacement or HX inspection is required.

faq.a: Yes — even a few seconds can warp the aluminum.

title: Flame Loss During Operation
shortDescription: Flame was lost during steady-state operation.
fullDescription: Viessmann Vitodens F.21 indicates the flame went out while the burner was firing. Causes include weak gas supply, contaminated ionization rod, or vent recirculation.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.
whenToCallPro: Gas pressure verification by technician.

faq.a: Annually as part of service.

faq.q: Why does this happen more in winter?
faq.a: Cold air mass changes can cause vent recirculation.

title: Pump / Flow Fault
shortDescription: Boiler did not detect adequate flow during firing.
fullDescription: Vitodens F.24 indicates a flow fault — pump not running, air binding, or closed valves. The boiler protects itself from dry-firing by locking out.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.

fixSteps.title: Bleed System
fixSteps.instruction: Bleed radiators starting at highest point.

whenToCallPro: Pump replacement is a plumber task.

faq.a: Annually or after refill.
Air-bound running can damage pump seals.

title: Differential Pressure Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Internal differential pressure sensor reading abnormal.
fullDescription: Viessmann F.25 indicates the differential pressure sensor (used for flow detection) has reported an abnormal value. May be sensor failure or actual flow problem.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.
whenToCallPro: Sensor replacement is a Viessmann technician task.

faq.a: Yes — but Viessmann-specific part required.
Yes — non-OEM not recommended.

title: Hi-Limit Tripped
fullDescription: Vitodens F.27 indicates the hi-limit thermal switch has tripped. Causes include flow loss, scale, or failed switch.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.
whenToCallPro: Investigate cause; switch replacement if needed.

faq.a: Some models — check yours.
Annual service.

title: Outdoor Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Viessmann F.30 indicates the outdoor sensor used for weather-dependent (curve) heating control has failed.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.
whenToCallPro: Replacement is straightforward.

faq.a: Yes — at fixed setpoint.
Yes — major efficiency benefit.

title: Boiler Pressure Low
fullDescription: Viessmann F.34 indicates system pressure has dropped below minimum (usually 1.0 bar). Causes include leaks, failed expansion vessel, or auto-fill failure.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.

fixSteps.title: Top Up Pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Use the filling loop to bring pressure to 1.2-1.5 bar cold.

whenToCallPro: Frequent pressure loss indicates a leak — call a plumber.

faq.a: Yes — but disconnect after to comply with code.
Once a year or less if no leak.

title: Gas Valve Fault
fullDescription: F.36 on Viessmann indicates the gas valve has failed its electrical self-test. The boiler locks out for safety; valve replacement is typical.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.
whenToCallPro: Gas valve replacement requires a licensed technician.

faq.a: Yes — gas valves are model-specific.
Less common; usually electronics-related.

title: Boiler Communication Fault
shortDescription: Internal CAN bus communication error between PCB modules.
fullDescription: Viessmann F.40 indicates an internal communication fault between the burner control and main board. Can be caused by loose harnesses or module failure.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.

fixSteps.title: Reseat Harness
fixSteps.instruction: Power off; reseat all internal CAN harnesses.

whenToCallPro: Persistent F.40 needs Viessmann-certified diagnosis.

faq.a: Often partially — but safety functions may be limited.
Reseating only — beyond that, technician.

title: Return Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Viessmann F.45 indicates the return-water sensor is failed. Used for condensing efficiency.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.
whenToCallPro: Sensor replacement may require partial drain.

faq.a: Some models lock out, others continue.
8-12 years.

title: Storage Tank Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Viessmann F.50 indicates the indirect cylinder sensor is failed. DHW priority is unavailable.
safetyWarning: Always shut off gas and power before any internal work. If you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas utility.
whenToCallPro: Sensor replacement at indirect cylinder.

faq.a: Yes — usually.
Depends on DHW config.

title: Buffer Storage Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Buffer tank temperature sensor reads invalid.
fullDescription: Code F.61 on Viessmann Vitodens with buffer storage indicates the buffer sensor is reading out of range. Buffer charging logic is disabled.

fixSteps.title: Re-seat Connector
fixSteps.instruction: Verify the buffer sensor cable at the controller.

whenToCallPro: If you cannot locate the sensor, hire a pro.

faq.a: Direct heating yes; buffer-fed loads will struggle.

title: Compressor Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Hybrid heat pump compressor sensor fault.
fullDescription: Code F.63 indicates the hybrid heat pump compressor temperature sensor is invalid. Heat pump operation is disabled until repaired.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Connector
fixSteps.instruction: Open service panel and check sensor connection.

whenToCallPro: Sensor replacement on heat pump module is a pro task.

faq.a: Yes - the gas boiler portion continues to run.

title: Cylinder Charging Pump Fault
shortDescription: DHW cylinder charging pump did not start.
fullDescription: Code F.65 indicates the indirect DHW charging pump is not running on call. Common after long off seasons or due to capacitor failure.
safetyWarning: Disconnect power before pump service.

fixSteps.title: Manual Free Pump
fixSteps.instruction: Use the manual unstick screw on the pump (if equipped).

whenToCallPro: Pump replacement is a drain-down job.

faq.a: Sediment after long inactivity in summer.

title: DHW Circulation Pump Fault
fullDescription: Code F.70 indicates the DHW recirculation pump is not running when commanded.

fixSteps.title: Check Power
fixSteps.instruction: Verify line voltage at the recirc pump terminals.

whenToCallPro: Pump replacement is a pro task.

faq.a: Yes, via the controller, but address the fault.

title: Mixer Motor 1 Fault
fullDescription: Code F.72 indicates the heating circuit 1 mixer valve actuator did not move correctly.

fixSteps.title: Manual Test
fixSteps.instruction: Use the actuator's manual lever to verify valve free movement.

whenToCallPro: Mixer replacement is a pro task.

faq.a: Typically radiant floor or low-temp circuits.

title: Mixer Motor 2 Fault
fullDescription: Code F.73 indicates the second heating circuit mixer actuator did not respond correctly.
whenToCallPro: Replacement is a pro task.

faq.a: Yes, until the mixer is fixed.

title: Solar Collector Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Code F.78 on Viessmann boilers integrated with solar thermal indicates the collector sensor is invalid. Solar charging is disabled.
safetyWarning: Solar collectors can reach over 300F - service when cool.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Cable
fixSteps.instruction: Trace cable from collector to controller.

whenToCallPro: Roof access required.

faq.q: Will the boiler still heat DHW?
faq.a: Yes, just without solar contribution.

title: Solar Pump Fault
fullDescription: Code F.79 indicates the solar thermal circulation pump is not running or has thermal lockout.
safetyWarning: Glycol can be hot under pressure.

fixSteps.title: Bleed Loop
fixSteps.instruction: Bleed air at the solar station vent.

whenToCallPro: Glycol service requires a pro.

faq.a: Yes, the boiler runs normally.

title: Heating Curve Out of Range
shortDescription: Configured heating curve outside allowed range.
fullDescription: Code F.80 indicates the heating curve parameter is outside the valid range, preventing weather compensation.

fixSteps.title: Reset Curve
fixSteps.instruction: Use the installer menu to reset heating curve to default.

whenToCallPro: Installer menu access required.

faq.a: Slope mapping outdoor temp to supply water temp.

title: Time Master Fault
shortDescription: Lost communication with bus time master.
fullDescription: Code F.85 indicates the boiler lost the bus time master, often after firmware updates or wiring changes.

fixSteps.title: Reconfigure Bus
fixSteps.instruction: Use installer menu to reassign time master.

whenToCallPro: Installer menu access required.

faq.a: Yes, but schedules may be incorrect.
